first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ, and memory_86 and memory_31 both validate that onboarding simplification (fewer fields, shorter flows) produced durable activation lifts in SMB cohorts. This directly addresses the activation decline without the retention risk flagged in memory_73 (promotional pricing) or the narrower applicability of referral incentives (memory_57, best for established customers when we need new ones). Verification of these two memories confirms the mechanism and prior lift magnitude. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) requires a different motion suited to pipeline expansion, not activation recovery. A standard experiment on simplified onboarding targets the immediate metric decline with proven mechanism and acceptable risk profile.
